rendered: The anode-free full cell, using a presodiated pyrite cathode, reaches an energy density of ∼400 Wh/kg[1], calculated on the mass of the presodiated pyrite cathode. The theoretical maximum cited for LIB technology is 387 Wh/kg for LiCoO2/graphite cells[2]. So the anode-free sodium full cell's value is slightly above that LiCoO2/graphite theoretical figure. The paper also says it exceeds current LIB technology once a packaging penalty is assumed. 50%[3] packaging penalty is assumed there.
